criteria.reason: Explicitly states no personal opinion or vote recommendation and leaves judgment to user.
Presents main pro and con arguments, attributed to UDC/sympathizers and opponents/economic bodies, fairly.
No clear factual errors, but omits required exact content (9.5 million, 2050) and result (~55% no).
Invites user to form opinion and suggests Federal Council archives and UDC campaign documents, though not balanced official booklet.

summary: Neutral and balanced, but incomplete on the initiative’s exact mechanism and vote result.
